postToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); TS=$(python3 -c 'import time,sys;sys.stdout.write(str(int(time.time()*1000)))' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s000' "$(date +%s)"); SID=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.sessionId // empty' 2>/dev/null); DIR="${HOME}/.copilot-obs/sessions"; mkdir -p "$DIR"; F="${DIR}/${SID:-unknown}.jsonl"; if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' "$INPUT" | jq -c --arg event 'postToolUse' --argjson ts "$TS" '{event:$event,timestamp_ms:$ts,raw:.}' >> "$F"; else printf '{"event":"postToolUse","timestamp_ms":%s}\n' "$TS" >> "$F"; fi
postToolUse.comment: Log tool execution results for observability
